plan: In a single-round sealed bid auction with value of $9, my strategy is to bid strategically. A bid around $8.5 gives me a chance to win while protecting against overpaying. With only one round, I can't learn from previous rounds, so I'll use a conservative approach balancing potential profit and risk.
